observations: Photo 0 shows a blue electronic toy piano with cartoon characters on the keys and a 'Bluey' logo on the top right.
Photo 1 shows the back of the same toy, with a battery compartment and a label that reads 'BATTERY HOLDER 43300' and 'BATTERY 43300'.
The toy has a handle on the right side, orange in color.
The keys are colorful and cartoon-themed, with characters resembling Bluey and his friends.
The toy appears to be made of plastic and is designed for children.
No screen or display is visible in either photo.
The seller claims it is an electronic piano with preloaded songs, but no screen or buttons are shown to confirm functionality.

claims.claim: A blue electronic piano with all blue songs and other songs preloaded
claims.evidence: No screen or display is visible in the photos to confirm preloaded songs. The toy appears to be a toy, not a functional electronic piano.
No visual evidence of teaching functions or keys labeled with Do, Re, Mi. The keys are cartoon characters, not musical notes.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included. Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The toy is not a functional electronic piano but a toy with no screen or display
risks.proof: A photo showing the screen or display of the toy, or a video demonstrating its functionality.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-functional toy, not an electronic piano

risks.risk: The toy does not have preloaded songs as claimed
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the screen displaying the songs or a demonstration of the toy playing music.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a toy without songs, not a full electronic piano

risks.risk: The toy is not suitable for teaching elementary music (Do, Re, Mi)
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the keys labeled with Do, Re, Mi or a demonstration of the toy being used for music education.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a toy for entertainment, not for teaching

risks.risk: The battery is not included or is dead
risks.proof: A photo showing the battery compartment open with the battery installed, or a video demonstrating the toy powering on.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a toy without battery, not functional

proof_requests: Photo of the screen or display showing the songs or music playing.
Photo or video showing the toy powering on and playing music.
Photo or video showing the keys labeled with Do, Re, Mi or used for teaching.
Photo of the battery compartment with the battery installed.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
